title.value: The Achilles’ Heel of LLMs: How Altering a Handful of Neurons Can Cripple Language Abilities

primary_area.value: alignment, fairness, safety, privacy, and societal considerations

TLDR.value: We discover that LLMs contain ultra-sparse critical neuron sets and propose a Perturbation-based Causal Identification method to locate them, showing that masking these neurons causes catastrophic model collapse.
